title: Mark Lorenc Charters
specs: Fish species include Walleye, Perch, Smallmouth Bass, and Lake Trout
Walleye average 3 to 8 pounds, occasionally over 8 pounds
Perch limit 50 per fisherman per day; first 100 perch cleaned by captain
Smallmouth bass catch and release only; fish run 3 to 5 pounds
Lake Erie known for trophy lake trout, fish can run 25 pounds or more
Everyone aboard must have a valid New York State fishing license
includes: All tackle, bait, and fish cleaning
blurb: Guests fish on Lake Erie targeting species including Walleye, Perch, Smallmouth Bass, and Lake Trout. Trips depart from Buffalo, Sturgeon Point, Barcelona, or Dunkirk, NY. The captain provides all tackle, bait, and fish cleaning services.
extraNote: If the weather is bad, the trip will not go and no charge will be made · If the fishing is no good, no charge will be made · $75 deposit is due to secure reservation; balance due upon boarding · Fishing from Buffalo, Sturgeon Point, Barcelona or Dunkirk NY · Walleye - May thru October; Perch - April thru May and September thru October; Bass - April thru October; Lake Trout - Dunkirk only - August thru September
